title: Dark dome received, reverbed
html_source: The echo of Mulligan’s lewd clucking caused by the dome of the National Library.

anchor.prefix:
is unremitting intellect is the hornmad Iago ceaselessly willing that the moor in him shall suffer. 

1986#174

 — Cuckoo! Cuckoo! Cuck Mulligan clucked lewdly. O word of fear!
anchor.suffix:
. 

 — And what a character is Iago! undaunted John Eglinton exclaimed. When all is said Dumas fils (or is it Dumas père?) is right. After God Shakespeare has created most. 

 — Ma
